name: Leak
description: The Leak (Balinese: Leyak) is a flying-head witch-spirit of Balinese folklore: a practitioner of black magic whose head detaches at night from her body, trailing entrails, to hunt blood — particularly that of pregnant women and newborns. The Leyak serve the witch-queen Rangda.
origin: Centred in Bali, Indonesia, with extension to Lombok and Java; the wider Southeast Asian female-vampire complex (Krasue, Penanggalan, Manananggal) shares the detached-head motif.
